title: If you accidentally double-hit the ball
question: If you accidentally hit the golf ball twice in one swing, what is the rule?

choices.text: No penalty – it only counts as one stroke

explanation: If you hit the ball twice in one swing by accident, it only counts as one stroke and there is no penalty.
